units.source_text: 野泽竹朝还是四段的时候，在名人家中同名人对局也发生过类似的事情。

en.t: Something similar also happened when Nozawa Chikucho was still a fourth dan, while he was playing a game against the Master at the Master's house.

units.source_text: 少年弟子们的嬉戏打闹声从学仆的房间直传到对局室来，野泽出去对他们说：过一会儿你们会挨名人斥责的。

en.t: The voices of the young disciples playing and roughhousing carried straight from the apprentice's room into the game room, and Nozawa went out and told them, In a little while you will be scolded by the Master.

units.source_text: 可是名人压根儿就没听见吵闹声。

en.t: But the Master had not heard the noise at all.
